accounting_scope: The bounded parser validates side<=16, columns<=6, coefficients<=256, queries<=B and canonical base elements before arithmetic. The input fully materializes host source, two spectra, points, expected remainders and rows; this is not a live streaming PCS/CUDA adapter. Device staging reuses a single (2*C+4)*2B*8 byte allocation for work, remainder, low block, two spectra and two twiddle directions. Low source blocks are copied high-to-low, with zero padding and one final device-to-host remainder copy. Host low/result/twiddles and runtime are additional. The final fixture row check uses Horner on a small remainder, not the canonical GPU multipoint tree. No change to production Rust Code/PCS, transcript, masks or MACs; no GPU execution, canonical cap, work/rate/peak admission, real Gamma or new Lean credit.

scope: Eight native Code fixtures export actual coefficient/pad offsets, native balanced/Newton spectra, final remainders and native RS query rows. Base columns and all three Fp3 limbs are compared against the C++ four-transform block pipeline at B=2/8/32/128. Zero source tails, nonzero original pads, repeated rows and zero dummy query points are retained. Altered pads, active factors, remainders and rows fail; oversized, noncanonical, negative, truncated and trailing input fails. The largest cap has a single partial source block, so its unused factors are not required to affect the result. Full sourcewise WHIR parity remains checked. The CUDA consumer of the same bounded format is compiled but not run.
